description: This file defines a final class 'ImmutableAttributesBuilder', which implements the 'AttributesBuilder' interface. It provides a fluent API for constructing immutable attributes represented internally as JSON objects. The class includes static factory methods to create instances, various 'set' methods for different data types, methods to remove fields, and to build the final 'ImmutableAttributes' object. It leverages the 'JsonObjectBuilder' from the 'org.eclipse.ditto.json' package and is annotated as '@NotThreadSafe'.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributesBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating immutable attribute objects, providing methods to set, remove, and build JSON-based attributes.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty AttributesBuilder instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an AttributesBuilder initialized with the contents of the provided JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the builder for different data types, with optional filtering predicate.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified key or JSON field definition from the builder.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON fields to the builder with optional filtering.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable Attributes object from the current state of the builder.
